name: PlotLine
author: Plotline-AI
description: Plotline-AI 2.0 - automatic LiDAR road-marking digitization (LAS/LAZ to a 3D GeoPackage: Highway lines and Other Marks polygons, client schema, EPSG:3763). Runs as its own program with a bundled Python runtime and the accepted AI model; nothing is loaded into NakshaAI-LiDAR. While a job runs, NakshaAI-LiDAR is paused so Plotline-AI has the full CPU and GPU; it resumes automatically when the job ends. Requires an NVIDIA GPU.
